title: Synthetic Supernova Light Curves Dataset

citation.text: Luca N. Synthetic Supernova Light Curves Dataset (Version 1.0.0). Generated using curve-to-curve diffusion model.

abstract: This dataset contains 5000 synthetic supernova light curves generated using a curve-to-curve diffusion model approach. Each light curve consists of 1601 temporal measurements representing luminosity evolution over approximately 400 days with 6-hour sampling intervals. The curves were generated using a diffusion model trained on real supernova data, conditioned on 7 physical parameters extracted by a regression model. The generation process uses synthetic template curves as starting points, which are then refined through a 200-step denoising process to produce physically plausible supernova light curves.
purpose: Generate realistic synthetic supernova light curves for training machine learning models, data augmentation, and astrophysical simulations where real observational data is limited or insufficient.

provenance.sources: Generated from a diffusion model trained on real supernova light curve data from train_preprocessed.csv
provenance.processing: 1) Synthetic template curves created with random physical parameters, 2) Parameters extracted using trained regression model (Best_mlp_res_for_diffusion.pth), 3) 200-step reverse diffusion process applied to generate final curves
provenance.derivations: All curves are synthetically generated through machine learning. No direct astronomical observations included.

structure.conventions: Column names are sequential integers (0, 1, 2, ..., 1600). Time sampling: every 6 hours. Missing values: none expected in synthetic data.
structure.relationships: Single table with 5000 rows (samples) and 1601 columns (time points). Each row represents one complete supernova light curve.

quality.validation: Generated using validated diffusion model trained on real supernova data. Model convergence verified through training loss monitoring.
limitations: Synthetic data may not capture all rare supernova phenomena
Limited to supernova types present in training data
Generated curves are interpolations within training data space
No observational noise or instrumental effects included
quality.usageGuidance: Recommended for machine learning training, data augmentation, and algorithm testing. Not recommended as substitute for real observational data in scientific analysis.

access.reuseGuidance: Suitable for academic research and machine learning applications
